scripts.text: Whoa, long time no see! But weren't you supposed to be dead?
scripts.translation: 哇，好久不见！不过你不是应该已经死了吗？

scripts.text: Ah, you must have been reborn. Well, I'm glad to have you back.
scripts.translation: 啊，你一定是转生了。很高兴你回来了。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I don't think you're ready to learn magic yet. Why don't you go finish learning the Basic Skills first?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我觉得你还没准备好学习魔法。先去学完基础技能吧？

scripts.text: Take your time. The more you learn, the more ready you'll be to learn magic again.
scripts.translation: 慢慢来。学得越多，就越能为学习魔法做好准备。

scripts.text: Well, since you have passed the Mage test once, I will not question your qualification. You want to have your magic skills back immediately, don't you?
scripts.translation: 既然你以前通过过魔法师测试，我就不再质疑你的资格。你想马上恢复魔法技能，对吧？

scripts.text: Wow, for some reason, you look way better than you did before. Anyway, I believe you will do a better job being a Mage as well.
scripts.translation: 哇，不知为何，你看起来比以前精神多了。总之，我相信你这次也能成为更优秀的魔法师。

scripts.text: Is there anything more I can help you with? If not, why don't you go test your skills? The world is waiting for you~!
scripts.translation: 还有什么需要我帮忙的吗？没有的话，就去检验一下自己的实力吧。世界正等着你~！

scripts.text: What, are you interested in the Mage guild? I didn't want to tell you this, but you don't belong here.
scripts.translation: 什么，你对魔法师公会感兴趣？虽然我不想这么说，但这里不适合你。

scripts.text: I am not sure why you're still standing in front of me, but I can tell that you're not meant to be a Mage.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你为什么还站在我面前，但我看得出你并不适合成为魔法师。

scripts.text: I want to be a Mage.
Hey, haven't you realized? You're aleady a Mage, silly!
scripts.translation: 喂，你还没发现吗？你已经是魔法师了，傻瓜！

scripts.text: One of these days you'll realize the power inside of you when you can make Fire with your mind!
scripts.translation: 总有一天，你会发现自己体内的力量，甚至能用意念生出火焰！

scripts.text: Hey~ C'mon. Quit playing games. You can't be a Mage because you already have another Job.
scripts.translation: 喂~别闹了。你已经有其他职业，不能再成为魔法师。

scripts.text: Hey, look at you! You're kinda cute~! Not my type though...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，瞧瞧你！还挺可爱~！不过不是我喜欢的类型...

scripts.text: Oooh, you're such a hot babe~!
scripts.translation: 哦，你真是个迷人的美女~！

scripts.text: Right, you said that you wanna be a Mage? Alright then, please sign the Mage Application.
scripts.translation: 对了，你说想当魔法师？那就请在魔法师申请表上签名。

scripts.text: Okay. Sign right there. Oh, you're very good at spelling. Alright. So your name is... {0}.
scripts.translation: 好，就签在那里。哦，你拼得真不错。那么，你的名字是...{0}。

You can find the necessary ingredients inside the Guide Book in this Guild. So you better look up what you need before you go.
scripts.translation: 所需材料列在公会里的指南书中。出发前先查清楚需要什么。

scripts.text: Once you collect all the ingredients you, use the machine in the center of the room to mix the solution. Good luck!
scripts.translation: 收集齐材料后，使用房间中央的机器调制溶液。祝你好运！

scripts.text: Whaaaaat~?! Right after you tell me that you wanna become a Mage, you change your mind?! Be a bit more decisive!
scripts.translation: 什么~？！刚说想当魔法师就改变主意？！拿出点决心来！

scripts.text: Oh, what a bummer. You haven't met the requirements yet.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，真遗憾。你还没达到要求。

scripts.text: Go back and reach Novice Job level 9 first. Don't forget that you also have to learn all of the Basic Skills before you come back.
scripts.translation: 先回去把初心者职业等级升到9级。别忘了，回来之前还必须学会所有基础技能。

scripts.text: I asked for...? I can't check it if you don't show it to me, right?
scripts.translation: 在哪里...?你不拿出来，我怎么检查呢？

scripts.text: You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 1 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation: 你应该制作混合溶液1号并带回来。现在再去试一次。

scripts.text: You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 2 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation: 你应该制作混合溶液2号并带回来。现在再去试一次。

scripts.text: You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 3 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation: 你应该制作混合溶液3号并带回来。现在再去试一次。

scripts.text: You're supposed to make Mixed Solution No. 4 and bring it back to me. Now go and try it again.
scripts.translation: 你应该制作混合溶液4号并带回来。现在再去试一次。

scripts.text: Hmm. I can see that you tried really hard. For a beginner's attempt, this is really good.
scripts.translation: 嗯，看得出你很努力。对初学者来说，这次做得相当不错。

scripts.text: Alright! I'm pleased to say that you've passed the Mage Test. I will transform you right away!
scripts.translation: 很好！很高兴告诉你，你通过了魔法师测试。我马上为你转职！
你现在是一名魔法师了！

scripts.text: Heh heh, I just wanted to say that. You know, it's a quote from a well-known movie~
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，我只是想说这句台词。你知道，这是某部名电影里的台词~

scripts.text: Now that you're a Mage just like us, let's be friends, okay?
scripts.translation: 既然你和我们一样成为魔法师了，就交个朋友吧？

scripts.text: For a cutie like you, I'd be happy to explain the requirements!
scripts.translation: 像你这样可爱的人，我很乐意说明申请条件！

scripts.text: I'd be happy to explain the requirements for a pretty girl like you!
scripts.translation: 对于你这样漂亮的女孩，我很乐意说明申请条件！

scripts.text: First of all, you have to reach Novice Job Level 10 and learn all of the Basic Skills. Then, you'll have to pass the Mage Test.
scripts.translation: 首先，初心者职业等级必须达到10级，并学会所有基础技能。之后还要通过魔法师测试。

scripts.text: You will be informed as to which Mixed Solution you will need to create after signing the application form.
scripts.translation: 签署申请表后，我们会告诉你需要制作哪种混合溶液。

scripts.text: Let me know when you are ready to become a Mage, alright?
scripts.translation: 准备好成为魔法师时告诉我，好吗？

scripts.text: This machine is the property of the Geffen Mage Guild and is used only for mixing solutions for magic purposes.
scripts.translation: 这台机器属于吉芬魔法师公会，仅用于调制魔法溶液。
溶剂：梦罗克水溶液试管

scripts.text: Please choose if you wish to begin mixing, or to re-enter the number of items to be mixed.
scripts.translation: 请选择开始调制，或重新输入要混合的物品数量。

scripts.text: Please place the items into the Mixing Receptacle. Make sure the item amounts are correct.
scripts.translation: 请将物品放入混合容器，并确认数量正确。

scripts.text: You cannot adjust or restore items once they are placed into the Mixing Receptacle.
scripts.translation: 物品放入混合容器后，将无法调整或取回。

scripts.text: If everything is correct, press the 'Mix' button when you are ready. Otherwise, press the 'Cancel' button.
scripts.translation: 确认无误后，准备好时按“调制”按钮；否则按“取消”按钮。

scripts.text: Place items into the Mixing Receptacle now. Please wait.
scripts.translation: 请现在将物品放入混合容器。请稍候。

scripts.text: Error: Item limit exceeded. Please enter values less than 10,000 try again.
scripts.translation: 错误：物品数量超出上限。请输入小于10,000的数量并重试。

An Eye for an Eye: When you take from a person, you must replace or repay in some way.
scripts.translation: 以眼还眼：从别人那里取走东西，就必须以某种方式归还或补偿。

scripts.text: Credibility is a Man's Currency: There's a value in genuine trust that cannot be measured.
scripts.translation: 信誉是男人的货币：真诚的信任有着无法衡量的价值。

scripts.text: What Goes Around Comes Around: Ultimately, you will be treated in the way you treat others.
scripts.translation: 善有善报，恶有恶报：最终别人会以你待人的方式对待你。

scripts.text: It means 'When you harm Another you will be harmed by him in an unavoidable situation'.
scripts.translation: 意思是：“伤害他人之后，终有一天你也会在无法避免的情况下受到伤害。”

scripts.text: A good neighbor is better than a distant brother: When you need help, you can count on those close to you.
scripts.translation: 远亲不如近邻：需要帮助时，身边的人更值得依靠。

scripts.text: Birds of a Feather Flock Together: You can look at a person's friends as an indicator of their character.
scripts.translation: 物以类聚：从一个人的朋友就能看出他的品性。

scripts.text: This Guide Book is the property of the Geffen Mage Association. Please handle with care.
scripts.translation: 本指南书属于吉芬魔法师协会，请小心使用。
